elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner

elements.evidence: "will conform in all material respects to its documentation and specifications" (qualified by "in all material respects")
"for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery"
No period stated for the services warranty in clause (a)
"or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software or services"
"will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance"
"free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code"
No services warranty period is stated at all
"repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid"

elements.element: Professional and workmanlike services standard (fallback carry-over)
elements.evidence: "performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

offending_extra_words: in all material respects to its documentation and specifications
reasons: The services warranty in clause (a) carries no duration; neither the preferred 90-day nor the fallback 30-day services period is expressed, so no level is complete.
Software conformance is diluted to "in all material respects", short of the preferred express conformance to documentation.
The remedy set adds "re-performance" and makes the election "at TrueLink's option", expanding beyond the playbook's repair/replace/refund and shifting remedy control to the Vendor.
"consistent with industry standards" is unnecessary added boilerplate that qualifies the professional and workmanlike standard.
